notes: An audit of the batch layer found four P0 defects. All four are fixed here, and two of them were reproducible on the shipped code. This is a correctness release: no cadence changed, no budget changed, no constant moved, nothing was scheduled or unscheduled. The decisions the audit raised — the model TTL, the enrichment budget, whether a batch interlock refuses or discloses, whether the daemon is still the right host for the heavy work — are the owner's, and they belong to the process-layer spec arc that follows, because each of them moves a published number and needs its own dated methodology
